candidates.name: EPS Estimate Intelligence
candidates.problem: A contractor or field-service operator needs a consistent estimate or planning range from scope, measurements and job costs, with transparent cost build-up, true gross-margin math, uncertainty and commercial lineage.
candidates.pricing: No approved public self-service subscription or machine-call price is advertised yet. The read-only planning preview has no checkout or payment side effect.
candidates.confirmation: Rough estimate generation does not authorize sending a proposal, accepting work, charging a customer or creating a customer obligation. The public preview is arithmetic-only and can run without a human UI. Customer self-service typed-name acceptance in the authenticated commercial workflow records the web event against the saved proposal snapshot but is not independent identity verification.
